name: Teakamamire no Danshi
source:
"Tatsuya Takigawa" became an overnight sensation—an idol whose popularity soared thanks to the striking contrast between his handsome appearance and timid, insecure demeanor.

But behind his rise to fame lies a hidden truth:

──He underwent plastic surgery.

Originally, Tatsuya altered his appearance with one goal in mind: to win the affection of his childhood friend, "Rumi Toono". However, after being scouted on a whim while out in the city, he unexpectedly finds himself thrust into the entertainment industry.

As he navigates the glittering yet deceptive world of show business, Tatsuya encounters a variety of women, including the up-and-coming idol "Misuzu Kudou". Some are sincere. Others have their own agendas.

Unable to see through their true intentions, Tatsuya convinces himself:

"It’s only because I look like this that I’m allowed to get away with it."

Swept up in fame, desired by those around him, and unaware of the consequences, Tatsuya slowly loses sight of what truly matters.

Manipulated, exploited…
──What awaits him at the end of it all?
translation:
“泷川达也”一夜成名，英俊的外表与胆怯、缺乏安全感的性格形成鲜明对比，人气飙升。

但他成名的背后却隐藏着一个隐藏的真相：

──他接受了整容手术。

最初，达也改变自己的外表只有一个目的：赢得青梅竹马“远野留美”的喜爱。然而，在城里一次心血来潮被星探发掘后，他意外地发现自己被推入了娱乐圈。

达也在光鲜亮丽而又充满欺骗性的演艺界中遨游时，遇到了形形色色的女性，其中包括崭露头角的偶像“工藤美铃”。有些是真诚的。其他人有自己的议程。

无法识破他们的真实意图的达也说服自己：

“只是因为我看起来像这样，我才可以逃脱惩罚。”

达也被周围的人所追求的名声所吸引，却没有意识到后果，他慢慢地忽视了真正重要的事情。

被操纵、被利用……
——这一切的最后等待着他的是什么？
